summary: Landed the argocd-hook image and the IaC/ArgoCDTools pipeline on phase/007-P4: a noble Dockerfile carrying terraform (unpinned, noble suite), terraform-backend-git v0.1.11, git, the distro python3 and presync/ at /app, running as `ubuntu` so terraform-backend-git's LOCK handler resolves a passwd entry; plus the Jenkinsfile (numbered tag + latest via helmCharts.kaniko2), .dockerignore, and the manifest's --no-push build verb. The image also bakes image/terraform.rc and image/homelab-root.crt — proven load-bearing: with the committed rc a fixture declaring pvginkel/homelab initialises, without it terraform init fails as the review-settled fact predicts, and the committed root alone verifies tfmirror.home's chain. kc project lint, test (53 tests) and build are all green from this pod.
